subject: Joint SE deep-dive & network access — scheduling
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Shah <samir@cloudworks.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-06-25T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Intro + SE deep-dive — align on timing and access

Hi Samir,

Thanks for the time yesterday — excited to get the SE deep-dive on the calendar so our engineers can validate latency/cost for the PoC. Quick asks up front to make the session productive:

- Can you confirm which customer engineers/security folks will attend (network, SSO, procurement)?
- Do you prefer an interactive screen-share (Zoom) or running a short demo in your staging VPC? If VPC, we’ll need the network checklist items below ahead of time.
- Proposed slots (PDT): Wed 6/30 10:00–11:00, Thu 7/1 14:00–15:00, or Fri 7/2 09:00–10:00. Please pick 1 or propose alternatives.

I’ve attached a short SE intro + our network checklist to this thread for your infra/security team. Karthik — SE lead — will run the demo; Aditya will cover success criteria and procurement touchpoints. Ben is copied for contract/discount questions.

Thanks,
Lauren

--
Lauren Bishop
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0142
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_SE_Intro.pdf, Network_Checklist.xlsx
From: Samir Shah <samir@cloudworks.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@cloudworks.com
Date: 2027-06-25T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + SE deep-dive — align on timing and access

Lauren — thanks.

Quick answers:
- Attendees: me (platform lead), Priya Rao (procurement) — looping her separately, and our infra/security engineer team alias (platform-eng@cloudworks.com). We may have one more SME from storage.
- Prefer a hybrid: Zoom for overview, then a 20–30m lab inside our staging VPC to validate KV/cache/network. Can you provide the network checklist items plus any required firewall ports?
- Of your proposed times, Thu 7/1 14:00–15:00 PDT looks best for us. If that works, Priya will confirm procurement windows for PO timing.

A couple of constraints for the VPC lab: we can provision short-lived access but need an IP range and the thumbprint of any hostnames you want to reach. Also we need a data-spec for the PoC sample (PII redaction is a concern).

Samir
Samir Shah
Platform Lead, CloudWorks
samir@cloudworks.com | +1 206-555-0199

Thanks Lauren / Samir. Thu 7/1 14:00 PDT works for our SE engineering rota — I’ll lead, and I’ll bring one engineer (Monica) for the VPC walkthrough.

Notes for the VPC portion:
- We’ll need a temporary service account and one SSH jump host if you want to run in-staging kernels; otherwise we can run a sandboxed demo and use representative datasets.
- Required outbound ports: 443 (control plane), 8443 (metrics), and 10250 (optional agent). If there are egress restrictions we can tunnel through a customer-approved proxy — let us know.
- For the PoC dataset we need a CSV with column descriptions and a sample of ~500 rows; ideally already scrubbed.

I attached a slightly trimmed Network_Checklist.xlsx for your infra team. Ben — can you confirm whether we should include an NDA addendum or a temporary PO/credit estimate ahead of the session?

—Karthik

Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Lauren — if 7/1 14:00 is confirmed, I’ll create the mutual action plan and add milestones (demo, procurement, PoC kick, review).

Hi all — Priya here (procurement). Thu 7/1 14:00 PDT works from procurement's scheduling side. A few items to note:

- We need an estimate for a 3-month PoC (headroom for 50k tokens/day) to start internal budget approval. Ballpark is fine ahead of the demo.
- Regarding data handling, please send the PoC data-spec and any SOC2 / encryption details (we saw a high level doc on your site but need specifics).
- Please include a DocuSign link or workspace for the SOW/PO if we proceed.

Thanks — I’ll join the call and add platform-eng for network coordination.

Subject: Confirmed: Thu 7/1 14:00 PDT — invite and pre-reads

Thanks everyone — Thu 7/1 14:00–15:30 PDT confirmed (I built a 90m slot to give us extra buffer). Calendar invite and Zoom link to follow.

Action items before the session:
- CloudWorks: please share the scrubbed sample dataset (500 rows) and confirm the outbound IPs you’ll allow for the short-lived access (we’ll provide ours once you confirm the VPC flow).
- Redwood: Karthik will run the demo; Monica will handle VPC access. Ben will circulate a preliminary 3-month PoC estimate and an NDA addendum if needed. Aditya will publish the mutual action plan doc.
- I attached our SE intro deck and a short SLA summary for procurement. Ben — can you confirm whether we should send a DocuSign SOW template ahead of time?

If anyone needs a different timezone view, let me know — we can auto-add alternative timezones to the invite. See attachments: Redwood_SE_Intro.pdf, SLA_Summary.pdf, Network_Checklist.xlsx, CW-PoC-Data-Specs.csv

Lauren
